That's heavy two-way churn, and net flow is only +265 SOL on that volume, so insiders or early wallets are likely exiting into retail demand.

The curve data supports this. Bundle share is 50%, meaning half the early supply came through bundled buys. The launch bot was present, and the first two minutes after graduation show a sell-to-buy ratio of 0.88. Drawdown is already 18% from the 30-minute high, and the pool is thin at 372 SOL. A $20 ticket facing a 1.4-5.1% round trip cost needs a sustained move just to break even, while a 30-second execution lag on a volatile, bundled coin means you buy into whatever the price is then. The base rate for random post-graduation buys is about -20%, and this profile looks more like distribution than organic accumulation.
